title: Zip Two Sorted Chains
statement:
Two linked lists are stored in one pool of `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means no next node). The first list starts at node `h1`, the second at node `h2`; either may be empty (then its head is `0`). Every node belongs to exactly one list, and the values in each list are in non-decreasing order.

Merge the two lists into one sorted list. If the merged values are `x_1 ... x_n`, print `(1*x_1 + 2*x_2 + ... + n*x_n) mod 1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `h1` and `h2`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print the value described above.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 13000`
- `0 <= v_i <= 10^6`
